name: value-swap
title: Value Swap
description: Swap a value in place with a vertical slide so the layout never shifts.
useWhen: A value changes at a specific story beat: before/after price, status promotion, a token flip.
You control the exact swap times.
avoidWhen: Values should cycle continuously as a montage: use rolodex-flip.
The value is a large number counting up: use rolling-number or number-wheel.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Values
variables.description: Comma-separated values; each swap shows the next one.

variables.label: Swap frames
variables.description: Comma-separated frame numbers (30 fps) where each swap starts.

variables.label: Distance
variables.description: How far the values slide, in pixels.

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: Slide direction of the outgoing value.
